basis: The S&P 500 closed 1.14% higher and the Nasdaq 1.69% higher as technology leadership, easing oil and lower Treasury yields supported risk appetite after the Fed hike.
VIX fell roughly 13% to the mid-15s, indicating reduced near-term fear but not eliminating overnight gap risk.
The Fed still signaled potential further hikes, and the Bank of Japan decision is the next major overnight cross-asset catalyst.

WTI settled near 101.91 after falling about 1%, while damage to three Saudi East-West Pipeline pumping stations leaves abrupt supply-reversal risk.
